source.publisher: Belfast News-Letter (via the Irish Newspaper Archives)
source.check: returned unopposed: listed under 'The following have been returned unopposed' (BNL 2 Jun 1949 p. 4, image-read); no withdrawals (BNL 3 Jun 1949 p. 4)

note: First election of the Carrickfergus Borough Council (six aldermen and twelve councillors, one alderman and two councillors for each of the six wards), after the Governor approved the charter of incorporation (BNL 19 May 1949 p. 5: 'Nomination day has been fixed for June 1, and in the event of contests, polling will take place on June 15'). There was no May 1949 urban council election in Carrickfergus ('In the cases of Lurgan and Carrickfergus the elections will not be held until August', BNL 4 May 1949 p. 5). Twenty-four nominations for 18 seats (BNL 2 Jun 1949 p. 4); five aldermen and six councillors were returned unopposed; polling took place on Wednesday 15 June 1949 in East Central, West Central and West wards (BNL 16 Jun 1949 p. 5). No party labels were printed. Poll date 15 June 1949: filed under 1949-06-15 (renamed from 1949-05-18, the general urban polling day, gap-fill 6 Nov 2026). The paper prints this ward as 'West Ward' and prints 'West Ward' again for Faulkner, Holmes, Gorman and M'Keown; East is the only one of the six wards not otherwise named, and T. J. Patterson was the East Ward member in 1952 (BNL 8 May 1952 p. 6), so it is filed as East Ward. Returned unopposed.
